feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 September 2026 9:54pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 28 September 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure migrating towards Scandinavia as areas of low pressure deepen to the west of Ireland.


##Wind##

East or southeast 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 overnight, increasing further 6 or 7 tomorrow morning and perhaps gale 8 in the west later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate overnight, then mainly moderate tomorrow and occasionally rough in the west later.


##Weather##

Fair, patchy rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 6 or 7, perhaps gale 8 at first, veering south 4 or 5 overnight into Wednesday, backing south or southeast 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in the west at first, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times, soon clearing to showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers and poor in heavy rain.
